intro: We hold a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹{{budget}} lakh for {{count}} published Polytechnic Course colleges in India. This list of the best Polytechnic Course colleges under ₹{{budget}} lakh is a fee filter for diploma programmes, and the branch on the card matters.
Government Polytechnic, Gorakhpur, is listed first with a Paint Technology diploma at ₹10,370. That is a specialised branch, not a general diploma in mechanical or civil engineering.
Uttar Pradesh has the most colleges here, followed by Madhya Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana and Maharashtra. Most listings are private, with three public institutes in our records.
listLead: These are the top Polytechnic Course colleges in India 2026 with a recorded main-programme fee of up to ₹1 lakh. Some cards are lateral-entry diplomas or second-shift programmes, so read the official title before you compare fees.
snapshot: Across {{feeN}} published colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private and {{public}} are public. Ghaziabad, Hyderabad, Indore and Mathura appear more than once.
No entrance test is tagged on this list in our records. Many diploma admissions use a state counselling process that is not shown on the card.
firstCollegesLead: Samskruti College and Ellenki College, both in Hyderabad, are listed with mechanical diploma fees of ₹15,000 and ₹15,500. PMV Polytechnic, Mathura, is listed with a petroleum technology diploma at ₹17,100.

Hindustan Institute of Technology and Management, Ambala, is listed with a Polytechnic Diploma (Lateral entry) at ₹30,000. A lateral-entry fee is not directly comparable with a first-year diploma fee.

sections.heading: Branch, shift and lateral entry
paragraphs: A paint-technology or petroleum-technology diploma leads to a different job path from mechanical or electrical engineering. Compare official branches, not only tuition.
State polytechnic counselling fees are often published as an annual amount. Confirm the official duration, usually three years, before you budget.

compare.heading: How to compare the best Polytechnic Course colleges under ₹1 lakh
paragraphs: A government polytechnic and a private diploma college can share this cap and still differ in workshops, industry ties and official yearly fees.
bullets: The official branch and whether the card is a regular, second-shift or lateral-entry diploma.
Whether the recorded fee is annual or for the full diploma, plus workshop charges.
The state counselling or institute admission process.
AICTE or state-board approval named on the official site.

faqs.question: How many polytechnic colleges have fees under ₹1 lakh here?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published Polytechnic Course colleges with a recorded main-programme fee up to ₹{{budget}} lakh. Colleges without a usable fee on file are excluded.

faqs.question: What is a typical polytechnic fee on this list?
faqs.answer: The median recorded total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}. Confirm whether the official notice is annual or for the full diploma.

faqs.question: What programme does Government Polytechnic, Gorakhpur, show?
faqs.answer: Our card lists a Polytechnic Course in Paint Technology at ₹10,370. That is a specialised branch, so check the official branch list if you want mechanical, civil or electrical engineering.

faqs.question: Are government polytechnics included?
faqs.answer: Yes. {{public}} public institutes are on this list, including Government Polytechnic, Gorakhpur, PMV Polytechnic, Mathura, and Shaheed Bhagat Singh College of Engineering & Technology, Firozpur.

faqs.question: Is this a ranking of the best Polytechnic Course colleges under ₹1 lakh?
faqs.answer: No. It is a fee filter. Branch, approval and the official counselling fee should guide the shortlist.
